title: The Teacher Who Changed Your Life Deserves a Pint of Ice Cream
summary: Carmen’s Best celebrates National Teachers’ Month with its Salted Caramel HOPE in a Pint, while giving teachers a special Loyalty Passport perk from October 1 to November 30, 2026.
